text: 12.3 1. Doug I met him while doing a summer job in England. We were both working in this cafe. He was in the kitchens and I was a waiter. Our boss was a bit of an idiot. He was really strict. He was always shouting at us and was just horrible. Anyway, we used to go out after work and we'd sit and complain about our boss. We'd talk about the things we wished we'd said to him. Nicola was always very funny about it.
